unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A resolution is a promise that you make to yourself.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: resolve（决定）的名词形式，新年决心

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is our responsibility to protect the environment for future generations.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 为后代保护环境是我们的责任。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 来自 response (回答/响应) + -ibility (名词后缀)，能对事情做出回应和承担后果，就是“责任”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Children always hope that Santa Claus will bring them gifts on Christmas Eve.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 孩子们总是希望圣诞老人在平安夜给他们带来礼物。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 西方文化专有名词，Santa 意为圣徒，Claus 是 Nicholas 的简称，合起来指圣诞老人。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: China has successfully launched many communication satellites into space.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 中国已经成功向太空发射了许多通信卫星。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：sat (坐) + ellite (跑)，像一个坐在高空时刻环绕地球奔跑的“卫星”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She smiled with satisfaction after finishing her difficult project.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 完成艰难的项目后，她满意地笑了。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 由 satisfy (使满足) 变化而来，把词尾 -y 改为 -action 变成名词“满意”。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 满意的，满足的，确信的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Are you satisfied with your exam results this term?
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 你对这学期的考试成绩满意吗？
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 过去分词作形容词，修饰人，表示人“感到满意的”。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 学校作业，课堂作业
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We should balance our schoolwork and after-school hobbies.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们应该平衡好学校作业和课外爱好。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 合成词：school (学校) + work (工作/作业) = 学校作业。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It's a kind of shuttlecock.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：Shuttle (穿梭) + Cock (公鸡/羽毛)，在网间穿梭的羽毛球。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: will start sightseeing right away
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 【教材补充词汇】组合词：sight（风景）+ see（看）+ ing → 去看风景。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My skateboard is really cool, and so are theirs.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆法：组合词 skate(滑冰/滑行) + board(板) -> 可以滑行的板 -> 滑板

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Building socialism with Chinese characteristics is our glorious mission.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 建设中国特色社会主义是我们的光荣使命。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: social (社会的) + -ism (主义/学派后缀) = 社会主义。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 东南 adv. 向东南方 adj. 东南部的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Guangzhou is located in the south-east of China.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 广州位于中国的东南部。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 合成词：south (南) + east (东) = 东南。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 西南方向的；西南的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Yunnan is a beautiful province in southwestern China.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 云南是中国西南部的一个美丽的省份。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: southwest (西南) + -ern (……的，表方位的形容词后缀)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Taikonauts must wear spacesuits when they walk outside the spaceship.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 航天员在飞船舱外行走时必须穿宇航服。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 合成词：space (太空) + suit (套装/衣服) = 宇航服。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A plate of spaghetti.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: spa(水疗)+ghet(给它)+ti(题)：一边做水疗一边吃意面。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He is an outstanding sportsman who has won many gold medals.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他是一位曾获得许多金牌的出色运动员。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: sports (运动) + man (男人/人) = 运动员。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Every sportsperson should respect the rules of the game.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 每位运动员都应该遵守比赛规则。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: sports (运动) + person (人，中性词) = 运动员，比man更具包容性。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The brave sportswoman broke the world record in high jump.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这位勇敢的女运动员打破了跳高世界纪录。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: sports (运动) + woman (女人) = 女运动员。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: People used to travel along the river by steamboat a century ago.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 一个世纪前，人们习惯乘汽船沿河旅行。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 合成词：steam (蒸汽) + boat (船) = 蒸汽船/汽船。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: In many fairy tales, stepmothers are often described in a negative way.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 在许多童话故事中，继母常被描绘成负面形象。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: step- (继，非亲生的) + mother (母亲) = 继母。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. (继父与其前妻或继母与其前夫所生的女儿)继姐, 继妹
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Cinderella had a hard time getting along with her stepsisters.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 灰姑娘与她的继姐们相处得很艰难。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: step- (继) + sister (姐妹) = 继姐/继妹。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Stonehenge is a famous prehistoric monument located in England.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 巨石阵是位于英国的著名史前纪念碑。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: stone (石头) + henge (悬石古迹，源自古英语) = 英国巨石阵。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: His face became red and painful because he got sunburned at the beach.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 因为在海滩被晒伤，他的脸又红又疼。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: sun (太阳) + burned (烧伤的) = 太阳晒伤的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Don't forget to wear your sunglasses on such a sunny day.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 在这么晴朗的日子里，别忘了戴太阳镜。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: sun (太阳) + glasses (眼镜，通常用复数) = 太阳镜。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Many teenagers regard scientists and doctors as their real superheroes.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 许多青少年把科学家和医生视为他们真正的超级英雄。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: super (超级的) + hero (英雄) = 超级英雄。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He picked up his surfboard and ran eagerly towards the ocean waves.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他拿起冲浪板，兴奋地向海浪跑去。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: surf (冲浪) + board (木板) = 冲浪板。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: World peace requires all countries to fight against terrorists together.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 世界和平需要所有国家共同打击恐怖分子。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: terror (恐怖) + -ist (……的人) = 恐怖分子。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: English is spoken by millions of people throughout the world.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 全世界有数以百万计的人说英语。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: through (穿过) + out (向外/到处) = 遍及整个空间或时间。
